summary_en: 11,825,411 shares tendered (61.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) at ¥540/share. Tender offer period 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-10, settlement 2026-07-17. World Holdings (acquirer) held 6,319,700 shares (32.9% ex-treasury) before tender; post-settlement nms Holdings becomes consolidated subsidiary of World Holdings.
title_en: Notice of Result of Tender Offer for nms Holdings Co., Ltd. (Ticker Code: 2162) and Change in Subsidiaries (Change in Specified Subsidiaries)
translation_en_brief:
World Holdings Co., Ltd. launched a tender offer for all shares of nms Holdings Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, ticker 2162) pursuant to the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The offer ran from 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-10 at ¥540 per ordinary share.

The tender succeeded with 11,825,411 shares tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 6,480,800 shares set by the offeror. No upper limit was placed on acceptances. World Holdings acquired all tendered shares, representing 61.6% of nms Holdings' outstanding shares (excluding treasury). World Holdings held 6,319,700 shares (32.9% ex-treasury) prior to the offer.

Settlement occurs on 2026-07-17, upon which nms Holdings becomes a consolidated subsidiary of World Holdings. Nine subsidiaries of nms Holdings (including Power Supply Technology Co., Ltd. and entities in China, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Vietnam, USA, and Mexico) also become consolidated subsidiaries of World Holdings. All ten entities (nms and its nine subsidiaries) are designated as specified subsidiaries of World Holdings for disclosure purposes.
